swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-0.description: Table of contents of the catalog: section names (Features, Technical Data, Pressure-Temperature Ratings, Cracking and Reseal Pressures, Materials of Construction, Flow Data, Testing, Cleaning and Packaging, Ordering Information and Dimensions, Options and Accessories, Maintenance Kits) with their page numbers.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-0.use_for: Use it to find on which page a catalog section starts.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-0.structure: rows: section name -> page number (two column pairs)
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-0.uncertain: Titled 'Check Valves' by the inventory; the printed title is 'Contents'.

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-1.description: Technical data per series: maximum flow coefficient (Cv), nominal cracking pressures in psi (bar) and maximum back pressure at 70°F (20°C) in psig (bar), grouped into fixed cracking pressure series (2C, 4C, 6C, 8C, 12C, 16C, CH4, CH8, CH16, 4CP, 8CP) and adjustable cracking pressure series (CA, 4CPA, 8CPA), with three footnotes (other cracking pressures on request; 3000 psig back pressure for the 25 psi spring; end connection limit).
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-1.use_for: Use it to find the Cv, the available nominal cracking pressures or the maximum back pressure of a series.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-1.structure: rows: series (grouped fixed / adjustable) ; columns: maximum Cv, nominal cracking pressure psi (bar), maximum back pressure at 70°F (20°C) psig (bar) -> values

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-2.description: Working pressure in psig (bar) versus temperature, °F (°C), for 316 SS and brass valves of the C (2C, 4C, 6C and 8C), CA, CP and CPA series, from -10 (-23) to 100 (37) up to 375 (190); brass has no rating above 250 (121). Footnote 1 recommends the optional inlet gasket for surge, shock or pulse service.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-2.use_for: Use it to find the working pressure of a 2C, 4C, 6C, 8C, CA, CP or CPA valve in 316 SS or brass at a given temperature.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-2.structure: rows: temperature °F (°C); columns: 316 SS, brass -> working pressure psig (bar)

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-3.description: Working pressure in psig (bar) versus temperature, °F (°C), for 316 SS and brass 12C and 16C series valves, from -10 (-23) to 100 (37) up to 375 (190); brass has no rating above 250 (121).
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-3.use_for: Use it to find the working pressure of a 12C or 16C valve in 316 SS or brass at a given temperature.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-3.structure: rows: temperature °F (°C); columns: 316 SS, brass -> working pressure psig (bar)

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-4.description: Working pressure in psig (bar) versus temperature, °F (°C), for 316 SS CH series valves, one column for CH4 and CH8 and one for CH16, from 10 (-12) to 100 (37) up to 400 (204); the top values carry a footnote marker (end connection may limit the rating).
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-4.use_for: Use it to find the working pressure of a CH4, CH8 or CH16 valve at a given temperature.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-4.structure: rows: temperature °F (°C); columns: CH4, CH8 / CH16 (316 SS) -> working pressure psig (bar)
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-4.uncertain: The footnote text ('Pressure ratings may be limited by the end connection. See Dimensions, page 12.') is in text section section-11, not in the table.

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-5.description: Cracking and reseal pressures at 70°F (20°C) of the C series: for nominal cracking pressures 1/3, 1, 10 and 25 psi (bar) the cracking pressure range and the reseal pressure (as back pressure or inlet pressure).
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-5.use_for: Use it to find the cracking pressure range and reseal pressure of a C series valve with a given nominal cracking pressure.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-5.structure: rows: nominal cracking pressure psi (bar); columns: cracking pressure range, reseal pressure -> psi (bar)
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-5.uncertain: Azure attached the caption 'CH Series' to this table; on the page it is the C Series table (CH is the next one).

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-6.description: Cracking and reseal pressures at 70°F (20°C) for two series in one source: the CH series (nominal 1/3, 1, 5, 10, 25 psi) and, as a continuation, the CP series (nominal 1/3, 1, 10, 25 psi), each with cracking pressure range and reseal pressure in psi (bar).
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-6.use_for: Use it to find the cracking pressure range and reseal pressure of a CH or CP series valve with a given nominal cracking pressure.
swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-6.structure: rows: nominal cracking pressure psi (bar); columns: cracking pressure range, reseal pressure -> psi (bar); first block CH, second block CP

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-8.description: Materials of construction of the C and CA series: for each numbered component (1 inlet body to 11 outlet body, incl. inlet gaskets, insert, O-ring, poppet, spring, center body, adjusting and locking screws, outlet gasket) and the lubricants, the material grade/ASTM specification for 316 SS and for brass valve bodies.

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-10.description: Materials of construction of the CP and CPA series: for insert lock screw, insert, O-ring, poppet, spring, body, adjusting and locking screws (CPA) and lubricant, the material grade/specification for 316 SS and for brass 4CP, 8CP, 4CPA and 8CPA valves.

swagelok-ms-01-176/table-azure-11.description: Dimensions and basic ordering numbers of the C series (fixed cracking pressure) and CA series (adjustable): per end connection type (fractional and metric Swagelok tube fittings, female and male NPT, male NPT/tube fitting, male VCR) and size, the basic ordering number, series and dimensions A, B and C in in. swagelok-ms-01-176/section-1.description: Cover page: C, CA, CH, CP and CPA series check valves with working pressures up to 6000 psig (413 bar), adjustable and fixed cracking pressures, a variety of end connections and 316 stainless steel and brass materials.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-1.use_for: Answers which series the catalog covers and their maximum working pressure, cracking pressure types and materials.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-3.description: Features heading for the fixed cracking pressure series: from 1/3 to 25 psi (0.03 to 1.8 bar).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-3.use_for: Answers what cracking pressure span the fixed cracking pressure series cover.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-3.uncertain: The matching statement for adjustable series (3 to 600 psi) went into the caption of fig-2.3.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-6.description: Caption text 'Compact, one-piece body' under the CP and CPA series feature drawings.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-6.use_for: Answers nothing on its own; see fig-2.3 and fig-2.5.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-7.description: Technical Data definitions: cracking pressure (inlet pressure at the first indication of flow), reseal pressure (no indication of flow) and back pressure (differential between inlet and outlet), plus the caution that initial cracking pressure may be higher after a period without actuation.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-7.use_for: Answers how cracking, reseal and back pressure are defined in this catalog.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-9.description: Basis of the C (2C, 4C, 6C, 8C), CA, CP and CPA pressure-temperature ratings: fluorocarbon FKM O-rings in 316 SS valves and Buna N O-rings in brass valves; with the note that CH or CP series valves may be considered instead.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-9.use_for: Answers which O-ring materials the C, CA, CP and CPA pressure-temperature ratings assume.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-10.description: Basis of the 12C and 16C pressure-temperature ratings: fluorocarbon FKM O-rings in 316 SS valves and Buna N O-rings in brass valves.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-10.use_for: Answers which O-ring materials the 12C and 16C pressure-temperature ratings assume.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-11.description: Notes to the CH series pressure-temperature ratings: based on fluorocarbon FKM seals; see Swagelok Tubing Data MS-01-107 for tube fitting end connections; ratings may be limited by the end connection (Dimensions, page 12).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-11.use_for: Answers what seal material the CH ratings assume and that the end connection can limit the rating.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-12.description: Cracking and Reseal Pressures at 70°F (20°C): definitions of cracking, reseal and back pressure and the caution about higher initial cracking pressure after a period without actuation.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-45.description: CPA series ordering instruction (add a cracking pressure range designator) and the caution that check valves must never be used as code safety relief devices.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-45.use_for: Answers how a complete CPA series ordering number is formed.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-47.description: Seal material option for all series: FKM O-rings standard in 316 SS valves, Buna N in brass valves; other elastomer seals available by inserting the seal material designator into the ordering number.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-47.use_for: Answers which seal material is standard and how to order another one.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-48.description: Seal material ordering example B-2C-VI-1/3 and the note that additional seal materials are available on request.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-48.use_for: Answers how a seal material designator appears in an ordering number.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-48.uncertain: Azure made the example line a heading.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-49.description: Special alloys: springs of alloy 400 or alloy C-276 and valve bodies of alloy 400, carbon steel, aluminum or other alloys are available in some sizes.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-49.use_for: Answers which special spring and body alloys can be requested.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-50.description: PTFE-coated springs are available in some sizes for the C, CA, CP and CPA series.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-50.use_for: Answers whether PTFE-coated springs are available.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-51.description: Inlet gasket option for 2C, 4C, 6C and 8C: PTFE-coated 316 SS gaskets reduce O-ring dislodging under pressure surges, shock or pulses; ordered with -FG (example SS-4C-FG-1) when not standard.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-51.use_for: Answers what the inlet gasket is for and how to order it.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-52.description: Deflector cap option for 4C, 8C, CP and CPA valves with male NPT ends: polyethylene cap that deflects flow away from personnel and keeps contaminants out, rated 300 psig at 100°F (20.6 bar at 37°C); -DG green or -DR red (example SS-4CPA2-DR-3).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-52.use_for: Answers what the deflector cap does, its rating and how to order it.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-53.description: Sour gas option: CH series valves are available for sour gas service with materials selected per NACE MR0175/ISO 15156.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-53.use_for: Answers whether a CH valve can be had for sour gas service and to which standard.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-54.description: Technical data of the sour gas CH valves: 5000 psig (344 bar) at 70°F (20°C), -50 to 300°F (-45 to 148°C), nominal cracking pressures 1/3, 1 and 5 psi, 1/4, 3/8 and 1/2 in. tube fittings, alloy 400 body and poppet, ethylene propylene seals, PTFE backup ring, alloy X-750 spring.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-54.use_for: Answers the ratings, cracking pressures, end connections and materials of the sour gas CH valves.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-55.description: Ordering of sour gas CH valves (replace SS with M, insert -SG, example M-CHS4-SG-1/3) and the ECE R110-type approved CH valves with Buna C seals for alternative fuel service: -40 to 185°F (-40 to 85°C), 3770 psig (260 bar), ordered with -11670.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-55.use_for: Answers how to order sour gas CH valves and what the ECE R110-approved CH variant is rated for.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-55.uncertain: The heading 'Valves With ECE R110-Type Approval (CH Series)' is plain text in this section.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-56.description: Special cleaning and packaging SC-11 (MS-06-63, ASTM G93 Level C): standard for C, CA and CH valves with VCR or VCO ends, orderable for other end connections with -SC11 (example SS-2C-1/3-SC11).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-56.use_for: Answers how to order SC-11 cleaning for valves that do not have it as standard.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-57.description: Oxygen service hazards: refers to the Swagelok Oxygen System Safety technical report MS-06-13.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-57.use_for: Answers where to find information on oxygen-enriched system hazards.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-59.description: C, CP, CA and CPA seal kits: contain an O-ring and instructions; for PTFE kits replace the material designator with T and omit the durometer number (example T-4C-K4).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-59.use_for: Answers what a seal kit contains and how to order a PTFE seal kit.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-60.description: CH series seal kits: contain bonded poppet, body seal O-ring, PTFE backup ring and instructions; add a seal material designator to the basic kit number (example SS-3K-CH4-VI).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-60.use_for: Answers what a CH seal kit contains and how its ordering number is formed.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-61.description: Metal gasket kit and spring kit text: gasket kits contain PTFE-coated gasket(s) and instructions (example SS-8C-K6) with the gasket availability footnotes; C, CP, CA and CPA spring kits contain a spring, two cracking pressure labels and instructions (example 302-4C-K2-1/3; add T for a PTFE-coated spring).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-61.use_for: Answers what the metal gasket and spring kits contain and how their ordering numbers are formed.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-61.uncertain: Azure merged the gasket-kit text, its footnotes and the spring-kit text across pages 15 and 16 into one section.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-62.description: CH spring kits (spring, two cracking pressure labels, instructions; example 302-13K-CH4-1/3), deflector cap kits (one polyethylene cap in red or green) and the Safe Product Selection statement (system designer and user are responsible for function, compatibility, ratings, installation, operation and maintenance).
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-62.use_for: Answers what CH spring and deflector cap kits contain and who is responsible for safe product selection.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-62.uncertain: Azure merged three separate blocks into one section.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-63.description: Warning not to mix or interchange Swagelok products or components not governed by industrial design standards, including tube fitting end connections, with those of other manufacturers.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-63.use_for: Answers whether Swagelok components may be mixed with other manufacturers' parts.

swagelok-ms-01-176/section-64.description: Warranty information (Swagelok Limited Lifetime Warranty), trademarks (VCR, VCO, Swagelok) and the catalog identification MS-01-176, RevN, December 2025.
swagelok-ms-01-176/section-64.use_for: Answers which warranty applies and which catalog revision this is.
